get.description: Answers 200 while the process can serve HTTP. Says nothing about PostgreSQL, Redis or any other dependency: that is `/ready`.

200.description: Each client-relevant optional feature (sign-in providers, integrations) by name, and whether this deployment has it configured. `false` means not configured, not unhealthy. Server-internal capabilities are not exposed here.

get.description: Answers 200 only when PostgreSQL and Redis both answer within their configured timeouts, and 503 otherwise. Why a dependency failed is logged, never returned.

503.description: A dependency is unavailable; this replica must not serve. Same body shape.

name.description: Dotted path to the offending field

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type. `about:blank` when the status code says everything.

title.description: Short summary, stable per problem type

instance.description: URI reference of the specific occurrence — the request path

correlationId.description: Correlation id of the request, for log lookups

email.description: Read-only here — changing it is an admin operation.

twoFactorEnabled.description: True once the user has confirmed an authenticator app; signing in with a password then also asks for a code.

hasPassword.description: Whether the user can sign in with a password. False for an account made through a social provider until a password is set; two-factor authentication only guards password sign-in, so it needs one.

current.description: True for the session this request was made with.

updatedAt.description: Last time the session was seen.

total.description: Total matching records, across all pages.

permissions.description: CASL permission rules the caller effectively holds.

sensitive.description: Flagged in the role builder. Not treated differently at request time.

fields.description: Attributes that may be granted or denied individually.

scopes.description: Scope dimensions this resource can be narrowed by.

credentialScope.description: Credential-scope group, when the resource is reachable by API tokens.

grantable.description: Rules the caller may put on a role. Anything outside this list is rejected, so the role builder can disable it up front.

key.description: The provider's own key, e.g. five_hour

peakUtilization.description: Highest percent of the weekly allowance used before it reset

displayName.description: The person's label, else the email

reportedPlan.description: Plan as the provider names it

planOverridden.description: True when the person chose the plan

monthlyPriceCents.description: Monthly cost in effect, US cents

priceOverridden.description: True when the person set the price

renewalDay.description: Day of the month the plan bills (1–31), when the person set it

weeklyPeaks.description: Weeks that reset in the last 30 days

apiCostCents.description: What these tokens would cost at API prices, US cents
What these tokens would cost at API prices, US cents

label.description: Readable name when the model is priced

apiCostCents.description: What these tokens would cost at API prices, US cents
What these tokens would cost at API prices, US cents
What these tokens would cost at API prices, US cents

rows.description: Every account, day and model, priced

isSystem.description: System roles cannot be deleted or renamed.

organizationId.description: Owning organization, or null for a global role template shared by every tenant.

permissions.description: CASL permission rules granted by this role.

status.description: `ok` when the dependency answered in time, `error` otherwise.

message.description: Present only with `error`, and always this one word. Why it failed is in the API log, never here.

database.description: PostgreSQL, proved by a ping within `HEALTH_DATABASE_TIMEOUT_MS`.

status.description: `ok` only when every check is `ok`; served with 200, and `error` with 503.
